cohort: Pregnant women with births between 24 and 42 weeks' gestation
finding: Compared to normoglycemic pregnancies, pregnancies complicated by diabetes, particularly pregestational diabetes, had significantly higher rates of cesarean delivery, largely driven by an increased risk of labor dystocia and, in the case of PGDM, fetal indications.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was controlled for in the analysis
